method: Project to existing GPX edges only; components and jumps remain separate. Along-distance excludes missing links. Per-node proximity is diagnostic, never an identity or route correctness decision. Geometry availability is assessed independently using exact existing OSM spans.

existingStartSegment.meaning: Reuse existing OSM planning geometry and existing source times; not a new field survey or independently verified official map transcription.
